scope: Independent read-only static review of main integration and debug state helper; UI implementation self-check listed separately

findings.resolution: Parent changed the displayed encounter lookup to the upcoming room for route-choice, capped at the final valid encounter. Fix verified in source.
findings.description: A route-choice for the first room stores room -1, causing activeEncounter to dereference a missing encounter during the main render.

checks: Debug operations clone snapshots and preserve their original replay history.
Main skips normal localStorage saves while sandbox is active.
Sandbox captures original run before first successful mutation; restore clears sandbox before restoring the original state.
Undo/redo include console actions and normal game actions while active.
Debug state replacement clears battle animation and increments action epoch so stale completion cannot overwrite replacement state.
No automatic deploy or commit operations added.
UI uses live engine data and native controls, without new generated art.
ui_self_check: Console always mounted, closes with Escape or backtick, and renders via top-level portal.
Window-capture toggle runs ahead of underlying document modal handlers.
Visible controls including details summary are included in focus trap; focus returns to previous control or console launcher.
Sandbox launcher remains visible when closed and explicitly says Saves paused.
Both UI TypeScript checks completed successfully during implementation.
limitations: This report is static code review. Browser interaction, screenshots, responsive layout, and final build validation are performed separately by the parent agent.
UI reviewer also authored DevConsole; independent review scope is main.tsx and debugState.ts only.
